question: A 결함 경보 카드에서 최고 점수 구역이 기본 표시 A 결함인가?
join: Pair equal-length rows and scores in original order before selecting 70 sample groups. Require unique IDs, complete group and zone coverage; compare shared group, target and raw score. Normalize candidate ID before /point-review/. Absent candidate is distinct from human unknown. Foreground flag is bad or center_out > 0.
consensus: Use non-null existing. Otherwise verify batch code sequence and one vote per rater and code. Majority of 3 or split. Any defect makes a defect card; otherwise at most two unknown+split makes normal, else undetermined.
ranking: Maximum unrounded score, then lexicographically smallest zone ID. Report exact maximum ties. Score >= threshold. Unweighted.

metrics.L1: A defect at top / assessable top among A defect alerts. Two-sided 95% Wilson.
metrics.L2: Any alerted A defect / all A defect alerts including unknown/split top. Two-sided 95% Wilson.
metrics.L3: Alerted A defect zones / all 45 A defect zones on 26 cards including misses. Sort group IDs, resample 26 cards with replacement including all zones, sum hits / sum defect zones per replicate. NumPy default_rng seed 20261114, same 2000 draws both thresholds. Linear 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles.
metrics.context: 2x2 human target x A defect/normal on L1; unknown and split separate. Chance = mean across L1 cards of A defect zones / all present zones including unassessed. Descriptive only. L1 by top foreground flag. Candidate distribution for A defect alerted tops, and L1 subset separately. Report assessable/alerts and missed/26 side by side.

decision.1: Stop on missing/duplicate/conflicting required joins or expected denominator mismatch; report IDs, expected, observed. Also mark unmeasurable if >=7 unknown/split among 24 alerts.
decision.2: L1 numerator >=14 of exactly 22: design surface false-alarm reduction.
decision.3: L1 numerator <=8 of exactly 22: among A-normal tops, strict human-defect majority -> review separate zoom prompt for [0.5,0.8); strict human-normal majority -> design location evidence, defer training; exact tie -> mixed, defer.
decision.4: 9 through 13 of exactly 22: mixed, defer. No secondary metric overrides branch.

limits: Region only, zero click coordinates. No same-mark or point inference, no extrapolation of error-selected candidates, no independent test, no new judgments/inference/training or protected inputs. Stop after recommendation.
